Why not make this an FT_STRING?

Hey @martin.r.mathieson. This field is used for a tree field for the BulkString length and value so I would imagine the field type would not be listed as a `FT_STRING`? Please correct me if my understanding is incorrect.

I meant the value part that appears inside the subtree (I deleted the branch, so don't have details to hand).  I think it was type FT_NONE, which meant if you right-clicked and generated a filter on it, you would get octets (34:35:36), whereas your example shows it always as a string.  It does also work with filters written in terms of strings ("abc").  Should this field always be a printable string?  I don't feel strongly about it, and will approve the merge request as-is.
